Specification: This specification models a system for managing requests in a multiprocessor or multi-agent environment. Each processor (Proc) can issue requests (Request) to registers (Reg), and the system maintains a queue of requests (reqQ) for each processor as well as a global partial order (reqOrder) over request identifiers (reqId). The specification defines the structure of requests, the invariants on the types and ordering of requests, and the main action (IssueRequest) by which processors issue new requests. The model enforces constraints on the length of request queues and ensures that the request order remains a well-formed partial order. The specification is intended to check for bugs in request ordering and queue management, as indicated by the initial comment referencing a bug found in an earlier version.
